public.title: Word Search
public.description: Return whether word can be formed by a path of horizontally or vertically adjacent board cells, without using a cell twice. Board is rectangular with 0 to 6 rows and columns, each cell one uppercase ASCII letter. Word has 0 to 12 uppercase letters. An empty word returns true.
hints: Backtrack from each matching cell and undo visited marks when returning.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Depth-first search explores paths with a path-local visited set. The worst-case time is O(cells times 4 to the word length).
